1) 5m intro + objectives
2) 25m runtime & networking overview (VPC options, KMS/HSM integration)
3) 20m model routing, fallback, and quantization tradeoffs
4) 15m deployment patterns (Dedicated vs Private + on-prem considerations)
5) 10m parking-lot Q&A and next steps

Available slots we can offer next week (PST):
- Tue 5/11 10:00–11:15am
- Wed 5/12 1:30–2:45pm
- Wed 5/12 3:00–4:15pm

I've looped in Marissa from Solutions so we can cover SLA/contract questions, and Grace from Security for KMS/audit logging.

Attachments: redwood_arch_agenda_v1.pdf (application/pdf)
